results.action: org.wikipedia.dev is already launched by the runner or setup; do not use launcher search or intents. If onboarding appears, tap Forward until Skip is available, then tap Skip. From the main feed, tap the bottom Search tab (nav_tab_search), then tap search_card to open SearchActivity.
results.comment: The initial layout dump transiently failed with a null root. Retry showed the main feed; tapped nav_tab_search and search_card, then confirmed SearchActivity with search_src_text visible.

results.action: Tap search_src_text, type sentinel text 'zzoversize', and confirm search_src_text shows it. Press system Back once to hide the soft keyboard while staying in SearchActivity.
commands: adb -s emulator-5554 shell input keyevent KEYCODE_BACK
results.comment: Confirmed search_src_text displayed 'zzoversize'. Pressed Back once; the final layout remained in SearchActivity with the sentinel text intact.
